config.source:
SELECT
  oi.order_id,
  oi.location_id,
  oi.order_day,
  oi.order_ts,
  oi.brand_id,
  b.name AS brand_name,
  b.cuisine_type,
  l.name AS location_name,
  oi.item_name,
  oi.price,
  oi.qty,
  oi.extended_price
FROM lakeflow.silver_order_items oi JOIN simulator.brands b ON oi.brand_id = b.brand_id JOIN simulator.locations l ON CAST(oi.location_id AS BIGINT) = l.location_id

SELECT
  complaint_id,
  order_id,
  ts,
  DATE(ts) as resolution_date,
  agent_response:complaint_category::STRING as complaint_category,
  agent_response:decision::STRING as decision,
  agent_response:credit_amount::DOUBLE as credit_amount,
  agent_response:confidence::STRING as confidence,
  agent_response:priority::STRING as priority
FROM complaints.complaint_responses

measures.name: avg_credit_amount
measures.expr: AVG(CASE WHEN credit_amount > 0 THEN credit_amount END)

measures.name: escalation_rate
measures.expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN decision = 'escalate' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)

config.source:
SELECT
  order_id,
  ts as processed_ts,
  order_ts,
  DATE(order_ts) as order_date,
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_ts) as order_month,
  agent_response:refund_usd::DOUBLE as refund_usd,
  agent_response:refund_class::STRING as refund_class,
  agent_response:reason::STRING as reason,
  SUBSTRING(order_id, -2) as location_code
FROM recommender.refund_recommendations

measures.name: avg_refund_amount
measures.expr: AVG(CASE WHEN refund_usd > 0 THEN refund_usd END)

measures.name: refund_rate
measures.expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN refund_class IN ('partial', 'full') THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)

config.source:
SELECT
  bl.brand_location_id,
  b.name AS brand_name,
  b.cuisine_type,
  l.name AS location_name,
  bl.trajectory,
  bl.growth_rate_monthly
FROM simulator.brand_locations bl JOIN simulator.brands b ON bl.brand_id = b.brand_id JOIN simulator.locations l ON bl.location_id = l.location_id

SELECT
  h.location_id,
  l.name AS location_name,
  h.hour_ts,
  DATE(h.hour_ts) as order_date,
  HOUR(h.hour_ts) as hour_of_day,
  h.orders,
  h.revenue
FROM lakeflow.gold_location_sales_hourly h JOIN simulator.locations l ON CAST(h.location_id AS BIGINT) = l.location_id

SELECT
  oi.order_id,
  l.name AS location_name,
  l.lat,
  l.lon,
  oi.extended_price
FROM lakeflow.silver_order_items oi JOIN simulator.locations l ON CAST(oi.location_id AS BIGINT) = l.location_id

WITH refund_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(agent_response:refund_usd::DOUBLE) as refund_amt
  FROM recommender.refund_recommendations
), revenue_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(extended_price) as revenue_amt
  FROM lakeflow.silver_order_items
) SELECT refund_amt, revenue_amt FROM refund_total CROSS JOIN revenue_total

lines: Multi-location food delivery operations monitoring across 8 locations and 24 restaurant brands.
Order data from Mar 2026 to Apr 2027 across all locations and brands.
AI-driven refund recommendations and complaint resolution outcomes. Tracks financial impact of operational issues.
Hourly order patterns for capacity planning and brand-location growth trajectories.
